items.probe: What is shown when there is no data — zero items, an unfilled form, or absent media?
What is shown while data or content is still loading (skeleton, spinner, progressive reveal)?
What is shown when the load or submit fails (message, retry affordance, partial fallback)?
What does the normal populated (happy-path) state look like at a typical volume of content?
What is shown for partial or incomplete data — some fields or rows present, others missing?
What happens when content exceeds its container — scroll, clip, wrap, or truncate?
How does the layout read at zero, one, and many items (singular vs plural copy, spacing)?
What happens with unusually long text — truncation, wrapping, ellipsis, or reflow?
